description: This is a PHP class file defining the 'LocalAuthProvider' class which extends 'AbstractAuthProvider' and provides local authentication methods, including password strength validation and session handling within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: LocalAuthProvider
classes.description: A class that handles local user authentication, including password validation and session management, as part of the OrangeHRM authentication system.

methods.name: getAuthenticationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of AuthenticationService used for authentication operations.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs user authentication by validating credentials, enforcing password strength policies, and managing session state. Throws exceptions if passwords are not strong or if other authentication issues occur.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the authentication provider's priority value for ordering or selection purposes.
